about: Royal Trust Line Technical Services are UAE’s leading Home Improvement and Maintenance Experts. Founded in 2018, RTLTS provides full range of home and property maintenance services across Dubai for Residential, Retail and Commercial Clients. Dedicated to working in the most efficient and streamlined way, RTLTS provides simplified maintenance solutions.

With a reputation based on quality, reliability and value for money we work hard to keep our Clients satisfied. With our Corporate office located in Dubai, the commercial hub of the Middle East, our team of highly professional staff and technicians assure our Clients of highest quality service.
